  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM sys.check_constraints
    WHERE parent_object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.audit_events')
      AND name = N'chk_audit_severity'
  )
    EXEC sys.sp_executesql N'ALTER TABLE dbo.audit_events DROP CONSTRAINT chk_audit_severity;';
  ALTER TABLE dbo.audit_events WITH CHECK
    ADD CONSTRAINT chk_audit_severity CHECK (
      severity IN (N'INFO', N'WARNING', N'ERROR', N'CRITICAL')
    );
  ALTER TABLE dbo.audit_events WITH CHECK CHECK CONSTRAINT chk_audit_severity;
